accepted_parent.scope: one generic aircraft, three fixed two-hour missions at h8/20/32, no ordinary failures, seed1, horizon36

manual_basis: Installed manual physical pp192-193 and 437-439: DAMRT is an exponential time-to-damage rate per million mission hours and may generate several occurrences of one damage type in a mission. Occurrences happen only after mission start. DamageItem.PROB is an independent consequence probability between 0 and 1, including zero; pp425-426.
source_delta: The control is byte-identical to accepted A02. The rate arm adds DamageType BATTLE-HIT, MissionDamage DAMP=0/DAMRT=3000000 per million mission hours, and DamageItem <ATTRITION>/PROB=0, plus a new ProblemDescription. All existing mission, system, schedule, seed, horizon and failure settings are identical. The zero-probability consequence is intended to let the sole aircraft survive repeated damage occurrences; it is not evidence of an attrition path.

pre_run_hypotheses.control: Native control should convert with zero errors and complete the three fixed missions at h10/22/34 with no damage, as in accepted A02.
pre_run_hypotheses.rate: If the native engine supports this configuration, it may log multiple BATTLE-HIT occurrences during one launched mission while the zero-probability consequence leaves the aircraft active. Exact counts and stochastic times are not preaccepted. Positive acceptance requires at least two distinct same-type occurrence timestamps within one mission interval, all after launch and before completion, with no attrition, plus reconciled reports.
pre_run_hypotheses.alternatives: Converter rejection, no damage occurrences, only one occurrence per mission, mission abort, attrition, or missing/ambiguous log identity is diagnostic only for this predeclared repeated-rate claim. A successful process exit is not native acceptance.

acceptance_gates: Independent static review of frozen source, exact diff, manual/dictionary basis and guarded runner before native execution
Two fresh serial session-0 SSH native runs under Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue preserving GUI PID13340
Exact 13/16 authored row-table roundtrips, zero converter errors, valid SXO/event/report for both arms
Event-by-event repeated BATTLE-HIT within one mission, no prelaunch damage or attrition, and 72 aligned System/Stock bins with terminal reconciliation
SHA-256 sealed raw evidence and independent read-only post-run replay
limits: One seed, one high rate, no actual consequence; this cannot estimate a population rate or verify exponential law, consequence frequency, item/system damage or repair.
DAMP/DAMRT mutual-exclusion rejection, continuous missions, multiple aircraft, GUI visual behavior and cross-engine parity are separate boundaries.
